name: delayed_current_corrections
definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (match_id) id,
    child_id,
    match_id,
    actor,
    reason,
    fingerprint,
    before_child,
    restored_child,
    before_parent,
    original_outcome,
    original_settlement,
    reversal_ids,
    financial_game_id,
    transaction_id,
    executor_role,
    created_at,
    generation
   FROM private.delayed_corrections
  ORDER BY match_id, generation DESC;

name: delayed_current_outcomes
definition:
SELECT o.child_id,
    o.match_id,
    o.terminal_revision,
    o.segment,
    o.reason,
    o.winner,
    o.organizer_delta,
    o.opponent_delta,
    o.evidence,
    o.completed_at
   FROM private.delayed_outcomes o
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_corrections x
          WHERE x.child_id = o.child_id)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_timeout_restored_children x
          WHERE x.child_id = o.child_id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT o.child_id,
    o.match_id,
    o.terminal_revision,
    o.segment,
    o.reason,
    o.winner,
    o.organizer_delta,
    o.opponent_delta,
    o.evidence,
    o.completed_at
   FROM private.delayed_reopened_outcomes o
     JOIN private.delayed_current_corrections x ON x.match_id = o.match_id AND x.generation = o.generation;

name: delayed_current_review_events
definition:
SELECT id,
    child_id,
    match_id,
    event_key,
    kind,
    actor,
    round,
    score,
    completed_at,
    receipt
   FROM private.delayed_review_events e
  WHERE kind <> 'child'::text OR NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_corrections x
          WHERE x.child_id = e.child_id AND e.completed_at < x.created_at)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_timeout_restored_children r
             JOIN private.delayed_corrections x ON x.id = r.correction_id
          WHERE r.child_id = e.child_id AND e.completed_at < x.created_at));

name: delayed_current_settlements
definition:
SELECT s.match_id,
    s.game_id,
    s.dealer_game_id,
    s.result_id,
    s.outcome_hash,
    s.child_count,
    s.organizer_delta,
    s.opponent_delta,
    s.created_at
   FROM private.delayed_settlements s
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM private.delayed_corrections x
          WHERE x.match_id = s.match_id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT s.match_id,
    s.game_id,
    s.dealer_game_id,
    s.result_id,
    s.outcome_hash,
    s.child_count,
    s.organizer_delta,
    s.opponent_delta,
    s.created_at
   FROM private.delayed_reopened_settlements s
     JOIN private.delayed_current_corrections x ON x.match_id = s.match_id AND x.generation = s.generation;

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.delayed_terms_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='delayed_matches' THEN
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','accepted_at','settled_at','revision']) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','accepted_at','settled_at','revision']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'delayed:frozen_offer'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF (NEW.id,NEW.match_id,NEW.ordinal,NEW.game_type,NEW.stake,NEW.config) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (OLD.id,OLD.match_id,OLD.ordinal,OLD.game_type,OLD.stake,OLD.config) OR
     (OLD.starter IS NOT NULL AND NEW.starter IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.starter) OR
     (OLD.terminal AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM private.delayed_corrections x WHERE x.child_id=OLD.id AND x.transaction_id=txid_current() AND x.executor_role=session_user AND x.before_child=to_jsonb(OLD) AND x.restored_child=to_jsonb(NEW)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM private.delayed_timeout_restored_children r JOIN private.delayed_corrections x ON x.id=r.correction_id WHERE r.child_id=OLD.id AND x.transaction_id=txid_current() AND x.executor_role=session_user AND r.before_child=to_jsonb(OLD) AND r.restored_child=to_jsonb(NEW))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'delayed:frozen_child'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
